scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Refuse capture if expected_sha256 mismatches; existing captured snapshot stays isolated from disk overwrite/delete; fresh open re-hashes new bytes
scenarios.recovery_rule: Recapture current verified bytes under a new snapshot_id and recompute cache key

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Never dereference closed/released FFI handles or closed datasets; refuse immediately
scenarios.recovery_rule: Re-open snapshot and session handles and track zero leaked live handles

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Cursors bound to epoch N fail against epoch N+1 after DDL mutation instead of mixing TEMP views across generations
scenarios.recovery_rule: Re-prepare query and re-open cursor bound to current catalog_epoch

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Half headers, truncated frame payloads, and streams ending without End/terminal never degrade into empty success
scenarios.recovery_rule: Reap child with zero detached threads and mark incomplete requests failed

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Streaming producer terminates cleanly with exit code 4 (stdout broken) or 0 (stdin EOF) with zero Rust panic
scenarios.recovery_rule: No orphaned children; partial consumer drops result without persisting completion

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Crashing worker marks ALL in-flight requests owned by that worker as WORKER_LOST (never claiming single-query loss) while sibling worker completes isolated
scenarios.recovery_rule: Reap crashed worker process, re-verify source content SHA-256, and re-execute incomplete list on fresh worker

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Bounded execution aborts at deadline_ms and refuses writing complete or negative cache entries
scenarios.recovery_rule: Verify zero cache files emitted and re-run within sufficient budget for Complete coverage

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Half-written .tmp files and corrupted .mddidx refuse in CacheOnly mode rather than serving empty facts
scenarios.recovery_rule: Reclaim .tmp leaks, quarantine corrupt index, rebuild from verified capture, and confirm hash equivalence against bypass

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: Fault recovery and physical deduplication never collapse distinct logical source occurrences into one entry
scenarios.recovery_rule: Verify dex_files row count and total rows equal exact multiplicity after recovery

scenarios.incomplete_handling_rule: 24 mixed cancel/quota/crash/cache/FFI rounds leak zero FFI handles, zero child processes, zero .tmp files, and bound RSS/handle growth
scenarios.recovery_rule: Compare post-warmup baseline against midpoint and final samples using native OS counters
